breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. The generated specification correctly removes this erroneous statement and instead includes the torsional shear stress τ from part (b) as a non-zero component in the plane stress state in part (c), with τxy = τ from torsion. This matches the ground truth prompt, which also omits the incorrect claim about torsional shear vanishing and includes both bending normal stress and torsional shear stress in the stress state analysis.
